name: LTX Studio
summary: AI video production studio built on the LTX video models, which are also released with open weights.
description: LTX Studio is a production environment for AI video aimed at creative teams, marketers and filmmakers, covering scripts, storyboards, shots and editing. It is built on the LTX video models, which are also available with open weights, through an API and as a desktop app. The Free plan gives 800 one-time credits; Lite costs $15 per month ($12 billed yearly).
